themes.evidence: Build and deploy agent-based workflows that automate research, sourcing, and due diligence.
Design production systems integrating LLMs, retrieval pipelines, and structured data into tools the investors rely on daily.
Shipped AI agents or multi-step LLM workflows in production (not demos).

archetype_rationale: Day-to-day the role is building and deploying agent-based workflows and multi-step LLM systems in production for investors; the JD explicitly requires having 'Shipped AI agents or multi-step LLM workflows in production' and centers on agentic automation of research, sourcing, and due diligence.
